title: Progress 91 Cargo Ship Docking – Saturday, March 1, 2025
description: The uncrewed Roscosmos ISS Progress 91 cargo spacecraft docked to the Zvezda Service Module March 1 after launching to the International Space Station from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan Feb. 27 on a Soyuz booster rocket. Progress is filled with nearly three tons of supplies and cargo and will remain docked to the space station for approximately six months.   Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
keywords: Expedition 91 Progress Cargo Ship Docking, Roscosmos
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
